categories.main_business_segments: Jinlong Machinery & Electronic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: consumer electronics components and electronic cigarettes. The consumer electronics segment includes motors, silicone rubber and plastic structural parts, touch display products such as micro motors, vibration motors, cover glass, touch screens, and display modules used in smartphones, wearable devices, smart home, and automotive fields. The electronic cigarette segment focuses on the research, development, and production of electronic atomizers and related accessories including disposable and pod-style e-cigarettes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced motor technology, including micro and linear motors, and has strong capabilities in mold development and manufacturing for silicone rubber and plastic structural parts. It employs lean production management to enhance efficiency and quality. The R&D efforts focus on product innovation such as fluororubber smart bands, smart phone protective cases, and high-performance motors for wearable and automotive applications. The company also develops smart electronic atomizers with features like APP-controlled power and temperature.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jinlong serves major domestic and international smartphone brands and consumer electronics manufacturers, with products widely used in smartphones, wearable devices, smart home appliances, and automotive electronics. The electronic cigarette products are mainly exported overseas. The company’s top five customers account for nearly 40% of sales, indicating a concentrated customer base in consumer electronics and related industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Guangdong and subsidiaries across multiple provinces including Zhejiang, Anhui, and Jiangsu. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and overseas markets, especially for electronic cigarette exports. Domestic sales accounted for about 43% of revenue, while international sales made up about 56%, reflecting a significant global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinlong operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of key components such as motors, structural parts, and display modules to consumer electronics and electronic cigarette manufacturers. It provides one-stop product solutions and participates deeply in customers’ product innovation and development processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and strengthening core businesses while expanding market share. R&D priorities include developing high-performance, miniaturized motors, advanced silicone and fluororubber materials, smart wearable device components, and innovative electronic atomizers. Jinlong emphasizes rapid response to market and regulatory changes, especially in the electronic cigarette sector, and aims to build a competitive core team to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of manufactured products including motors, structural parts, touch display modules, and electronic cigarette components. The company operates on a product sales model with direct sales channels, serving both domestic and international customers. It also derives income from government subsidies and occasional investment disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinlong is one of the earliest and few listed companies in China specializing in motor manufacturing for consumer electronics. It faces intense competition in the consumer electronics components industry due to market saturation and price wars, with market share increasingly concentrated among leading players. In the electronic cigarette segment, it competes amid tightening regulations and increasing overseas competition. The company positions itself as a quality-focused, innovative supplier with strong customer relationships and integrated product solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jinlong reported operating revenue of approximately 1.49 billion RMB, a 44% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 121 million RMB, though the loss narrowed compared to 2023. The company’s total assets stood at about 1.64 billion RMB, with equity attributable to shareholders at 661 million RMB. Despite recent declines, the company is implementing cost controls and operational optimizations to stabilize and improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinlong emphasizes its long-standing expertise in micro motor technology and structural parts manufacturing, combined with a comprehensive one-stop product solution capability that integrates R&D, production, and customer service. Its ability to rapidly respond to customer needs and deliver high-quality, innovative components tailored for consumer electronics and electronic cigarettes differentiates it in a highly competitive market. The company also leverages advanced materials and smart product features to enhance user experience and product performance.
